name: Shimamoto (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Shimamoto town emblem in red: an outlined stylised fan of petals above horizontal lines.
history: Municipal flag of Shimamoto, a town in Osaka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 10 December 1968.

features.role: Shimamoto town emblem — an outlined stylised fan of petals above horizontal lines
